science.title: Voyager stereo elevations with published limb-profile data, in kilometres relative to the source reference ellipsoid. Fixed relief lighting reveals slopes; gray grid marks missing measurements. 2.88 km grid spacing is not uniform effective elevation resolution.

science.label: Geology
science.title: Ten historical geologic units digitized from Voyager-era mapping. Registration reconstructed from crater landmarks; four independent checks differ by 0.33–0.83° (about 4.5–11.4 km). Colors identify interpreted units, not measured composition. Gray grid marks unmapped or unresolved overlapping units; structural linework is not shown.
